name: Agent Control Surface
description: The kind of entrypoint selected for an agent interaction. Classify the entrypoint, not all surfaces a product offers. Deployment topology, transport, protocol and permission to use the surface are separate.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: The selected entrypoint has not been classified.

values.label: Interactive UI
values.description: A terminal, desktop, browser or IDE interaction surface intended for its operator. This label does not authorize automation or input injection.

values.label: Bounded invocation
values.description: A non-interactive executable invocation that receives one unit of work and terminates. Streaming its output does not make it a session API.

values.label: Session or run API
values.description: A message-based API for session or run operations, including triggers, prompts, observation and lifecycle requests. It may use a child-process stream or a local or remote server.

values.label: Embedded API
values.description: A library call boundary hosting or exposing an agent loop within the caller's process. A library wrapping a remote API does not make the remote boundary embedded.
